text:
Maya: Kicked off a quick EAP with HelixSilicon (NDA executed). Partner sending 2 devkits next Tue. Primary ask: validate our inference runtime on their SoC and collect perf + quality deltas.
Carlos: I'll take the benchmark harness and result ingestion. Plan to add a CI job that publishes a concise CSV + JSON summary to s3.
Ivy: I'll prep the models and quant configs. Suggest starting with redwood/llama2-7b-fp and redwood/llama2-13b-q4 as the main pairs.
Maya: Schedule idea: Day0 onboarding + image boot, Day1 perf tuning, Day2 latency and cold-start, Day3 analysis + partner readout. Keep 3 business-day turnaround for first pass.
Carlos: Bench command for reproducibility:
```
./bench --model redwood/llama2-13b-q4 --suite perf,latency --batch 2 --devkit /mnt/helix0 --out s3://redwood-eap/helix/run1.json
```
Tag: helix-eap-2026.
Ivy: Dataset subset will be eval/minicore-1k.jsonl. Uploading to s3://redwood-eap/helix/manifest.json by EOD.
Maya: Partner constraint: embargo on any external numbers until joint validation sign-off. Also they require we run with their provided firmware blob and report any kernel panics back.
Carlos: Proposed QA gates: latency p95 <= 200ms for 13B-q4, throughput >= 80 tok/s, perplexity delta <= 4% vs baseline. If a gate fails we document and propose mitigations.
ops-bot: Ops ticket created: OPS-6193 for devkit intake and network setup. Link: https://ops.redwood/tickets/6193
Ivy: I'll stage model artifacts in the eap bucket and include a small human-eval rubric. Maya, do you want to invite Helix eng to a readout if results look promising?
Maya: Yes, plan for an internal readout first, then partner review. If green, we'll coordinate a marketplace tile + joint announcement slot later.
Carlos: Action items: Carlos -> PR for bench CI, Ivy -> upload artifacts, Maya -> schedule readout invite and add legal notes to the thread. We'll checkpoint tomorrow 10am PT.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Keeping updates here.
